method: I rated head 7744d1c (polishA) against r0 (before) with the after renders r1/q02 and r2/q03-q05 (930x575, boarding). I diffed each pair pixel by pixel (tile means of the L difference, maps in scratchpad/w14a/d_q02/q03/q05.png; pairs p_q0N.png). I also rendered four studio variants from b3/test.html through suiteUnit({bed, doors, divider}): v1 bed+doors closed, v2 bed seen from the aisle, v3 ottoman close-up and v4 centre pair with the divider up plus bed+doors on one side (scratchpad/w14a/out/, sheet_v.png). Sampling is PIL box mean / p10 / p90 / std of luminance plus hue (bin/samp.py). References are omaat_f11, f57, f59, f2, f5 and f40, and ANA f_17304. Lighting is noted but not scored.

In q04 the duvet in shade (440-520, 320-380) went from L227 to L207, and (470-520, 320-400) from L223 to L202. omaat_f59 bed (400-600 x 600-800) is L208 and f_17304's duvet (270-480, 240-400) is L214, so the render now sits on the photos. The remainder is the hard-edged sun patches (L236-243, p90 244-245), which is lighting.

calibration.earlier_issue: w13a LOW: the aisle drape reads as a crisp ledge projecting past the duvet
calibration.status: partly fixed. The ledge no longer projects; the drape now steps in under the rounded edge (z_drape.png). At column x 560 the profile is duvet L213, a dip, then a flat 10 px skirt at L186-189. From the aisle (v2, z_v2.png) it reads as a flat vertical white board with a row of speckle dots along its top, where its top face (0.43+0.06 = 0.49) is coplanar with the duvet base at 0.49.

details.detail: Bed mode (pad, duvet, fold, drape, pillows)
details.refs: q04 / v1 / v2 against omaat_f57, f59 and f_17304. The tone is now right (L202-207 against L208-214). The remaining gaps are form: a flat slab without f59's soft wrinkles or f_17304's satin stripe, a decal-like fold corner, and a rigid drape skirt.

q03 under/top was 55/139 = 0.40 before and is 16/139 = 0.12 now, against omaat_f11's 24/116 = 0.21. The void now reads open and dark, but it overshoots: f11 p90 under the tray is 46 against 19 here, and f11's grey plinth line (750-775, L75) is not visible in q03, because the strip sits 0.13 m back. In the studio (v3) the recess floor reads as a lit pink-tan tile (#897463 L121).

q02 panel (372-558, 288-384) went from L113 / p90 153 to L116 / p90 167, and q05 (560-650, 280-380) from L112 to L114. That is a faint sheen gain with no visible rim lines yet. Neutral to slightly positive.

changeVerdicts.1 bed linen darker: helped. Duvet L227 -> L207 (f59 L208, f_17304 L214); bed clip 31.8 % -> 20.7 %. The remaining clip is the sun patch (lighting).
changeVerdicts.2 drape tucked: helped a little. The projecting lip is gone, but it still reads as a rigid skirt with a coplanar seam (low).
changeVerdicts.3 ottoman recess: helped, with an overshoot. Under/top 0.40 -> 0.12 against f11's 0.21; the plinth line is hidden.
changeVerdicts.4 fShell r 0.34: neutral. +2-3 L on the shell panels, p90 +14 in q02, no visible rim-line change.
